text: March 2017. Live on BBC World News, Professor Robert Kelly was explaining South Korean politics. Then the door behind him opened. *His 4-year-old daughter marched in.* Then *the baby rolled in* on a walker. Then his wife slid in on her knees and dragged them both out. He kept talking the whole time. *Millions watched it.* Every working parent felt it. Hit like if your kids have done this.
title: The Kids Who Crashed the BBC 😂✨
